notes.title: Mea Culpa
notes.content:
After receiving a large amount of feedback from players, the game development team of "The Memory of Mallet" has carefully discussed and made some modifications to the game content. The content includes: certain plot and scene CG in the Ab chapter of the character; Place names of certain real-life scenes (* school names)
The original intention of the production team of "The Memory of Mallet" was to promote the school, but the actual purpose of promoting the school after the promotion did not fit the game content, which brought a bad experience to classmates. The production team of 'The Memory of Mallet' has conducted a solemn review of this and deeply apologizes for the confusion caused to all classmates.
All the protagonist prototypes in this game are familiar with and have participated to some extent in the production of 'The Memory of Mallet'. Although the game is based on real-life stories, it has undergone sufficient artistic processing. Please do not overly associate the characters and plot in the game with reality.
Finally, the production team of 'The Memory of Mallet' apologizes for the inconvenience caused to the players. Sorry, it has affected everyone's normal gaming experience.
